# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1989

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 2**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance appropriating a total of P 16,625.00 from the General Fund, and P 96,000.00 from the Infrastructure Fund and Supplemental Budget Nos. 2 and 3, for a combined total for 1989 to be made available as appropriations of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The funds were taken from the municipal treasury, unconditional internal revenue allotment and 20% Infrastructure Fund. The purpose includes additional per diem, representation allowance, and medicare contributions for additional members of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] coming from the Katipunan Bayan, as well as the purchase of a book ("Philippine Legal Forms") for the Municipal Trial Court Judge.

**Total from General Fund:** P 16,625.00
**Total from Infrastructure Fund and Supplemental Budget Nos. 2 & 3:** P 96,000.00 (comprising P 16,625.00 from the General Fund and P 96,000.00 from the Infrastructure Fund, totaling P 112,625.00 in combined amounts)

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** There is hereby appropriated from the funds of the municipal treasury, unconditional internal revenue allotment and 20% Infrastructure Fund, to be made as appropriations of the Municipality of Pitogo, covering the amount of P 112,625.00 (Sixteen Thousand Six Hundred Twenty Five Pesos from the General Fund, and Ninety Six Thousand Pesos from the Infrastructure Fund) respectively.
- **Section 2.** Supplemental Budget Nos. 2 and 3, General Fund and Supplemental Budget No. 3, Infrastructure Fund are made available as integral part of this ordinance.
- **Section 3.** This appropriation ordinance shall take effect after review by the Provincial Budget Officer.
